Class IslandSquare

java.lang.Object
model.squares.Square
model.squares.IslandSquare
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rentable
public class IslandSquare extends Square implements Rentable
Represents an Island square, functioning similarly to a Property.

This class demonstrates how different types of properties can be implemented using the Rentable interface.

    • landOn

      public void landOn(Player player)
      Description copied from class: Square
      Defines the action to be taken when a player lands on this square.

      This method applies polymorphism, allowing different square types to handle player interactions differently (e.g., paying rent, drawing a card, or going to jail).

      Specified by:
      landOn in class Square
      Parameters:
